blurb:
Experience downtown Nashville through the eyes of a local on this award-winning 3 to 3.5-hour walking food tour. Recognized by Tripadvisor as one of the Top 1% of Experiences Worldwide, A Little Local Flavor has welcomed 23,000+ guests, earned 2,700+ five-star reviews, and helped direct nearly $1.5 million to locally owned Nashville businesses.

Come hungry! Visit 6 locally owned restaurants and tasting rooms as you savor Tennessee barbecue, shrimp and grits, a locally brewed beer, two handcrafted cocktails, and a tasting at a local distillery. Dine at a James Beard Award semifinalist, explore one of downtown Nashville's most historic venues, hear the stories behind iconic landmarks, and soak in the city's legendary live music.

Generous tastings add up to a hearty meal. Every stop is locally owned, every dish is made from scratch, and our passionate local guides share insider stories and recommendations to help you experience Nashville like a local.
